reviews.comment: Emma approaches learning with genuine enthusiasm. Listening stands out this month; with continued practice the rest will follow.

reviews.comment: This month Emma showed lovely progress. Reading is developing nicely and participation has been consistently strong.
reviews.strengths: A confident learner who is happy to take risks and learn from mistakes.
reviews.improvements: Building the confidence to answer in full sentences without prompting.
reviews.goals: Write a five-sentence paragraph independently; learn 20 new topic words.
reviews.parentNotes: Please encourage Emma to read aloud for ten minutes each evening — it is making a real difference. Thank you for your support at home.
